recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for this issue unless a future work group decision separately clarifies complex-element :missing behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-13348 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked whether simple elements that are present but lack a value, such as a primitive with only extensions or a Coding/Identifier without indexed components, should be returned by :missing searches. The accepted resolution was to indicate that :missing for simple data type elements matches omitted elements or elements with no @value specified.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 13208, imported as git commit 96fa8761670c825ab721b850cf4691677b074533, which added the requested guidance to source/search.html.
additional_context: The active source/search.html missing-modifier section now carries the same rule and the adjacent summary row agrees after the already-published FHIR-14955 reconciliation on the combined branch. A 2023 Zulip implementers thread quotes and confirms the current absent/no-value interpretation, and no Confluence reference or conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active core source already satisfies the seed resolution and duplicating the guidance elsewhere would not improve conformance clarity.
